_comment: Safety guards for automated content pipelines. These prevent your pipeline from going rogue — publishing duplicates, breaking the repo, blowing your hosting bill, or damaging SEO.

repoLock.description: Mutex lock preventing concurrent git operations. If two scripts try to commit simultaneously, one corrupts the other's state.
repoLock.implementation: mkdir-based lock at /tmp/your-repo.lock with PID file. Stale locks (dead PID) are auto-stolen. Every script that touches git must acquire the lock first.

rebaseGuard.description: Check for .git/rebase-merge, .git/rebase-apply, or .git/MERGE_HEAD before any git operation. A stuck rebase kills all automation.
rebaseGuard.action: Abort with a logged error. Never try to auto-resolve a rebase — alert a human.

preCommitHook.description: Block the content writer from committing directly. All commits go through a pipeline script that validates first.
checks: no template phrases in new content

cannibalizationCheck.description: Before creating a new page, grep existing content for the same entity + metric. If a page already covers 'Anthropic revenue', UPDATE it instead of creating a duplicate.
cannibalizationCheck.implementation: Entity extraction from the topic, then grep across all content files. Match on entity + intent (revenue vs valuation vs IPO).

categoryRegistry.description: For ranking/comparison pages, maintain a registry mapping category → canonical URL. Only one 'best data rooms' page should exist.
categoryRegistry.implementation: JSON map of category → slug. Check before creating any ranking-type content.

timestampJitter.description: Batch-published content gets timestamps on exact 15-minute marks (09:30:00, 10:00:00) which reads as machine-generated. Hash the slug to shift timestamps backward by 1-14 minutes.
timestampJitter.implementation: SHA1(slug) mod 14 + 1 = minutes to subtract. Deterministic (same result on re-runs), always backward (never future), organic-looking seconds.

nobuildTag.description: Automation commits append [nobuild] to skip their own Vercel build. Content rides the next scheduled build window.
nobuildTag.implementation: vercel-ignore.sh checks commit message for [nobuild] and exits 0 (skip)

deployTick.description: Daily safety net (e.g., 4:45pm) that checks if user-visible content is stranded (committed but never deployed). If so, pushes one empty commit to force exactly one build.
deployTick.implementation: Compare production's deployed SHA (from /version.json) against the latest remote SHA. Only tick if the diff includes user-visible files.

contentOnlySkip.description: Commits that only change markdown/JSON files skip the build — ISR handles them without a full redeploy.
contentOnlySkip.implementation: git diff against previous SHA, check if any non-content file changed

buildBudget.description: Target 4-6 builds per day max. More than that and you're burning hosting credits on redundant rebuilds.
buildBudget.monitoring: Track build count in deploy logs, alert if >8 builds in a day

heartbeat.description: Runs every 2 hours. If the scheduled daily publish never fired (Mac was asleep, CI failed), re-triggers it. Prevents content going stale because of infrastructure issues.
heartbeat.cooldown: 90 minutes between catch-up attempts (don't hammer on repeated failures)
heartbeat.alertThreshold: 20 hours without a publish — notify human

recoveryJob.description: If the pipeline discovers missed publishes (e.g., blog was dead for 2 days), it queues makeup posts at a throttled rate rather than dumping them all at once.

redirectCollisionGuard.description: Before creating a new page, check that the slug doesn't collide with an existing redirect. A page and a 301 redirect at the same path = unpredictable behavior.
redirectCollisionGuard.implementation: Check your redirect config and existing pages before committing new content

sitemapIntegrity.description: Every URL in the sitemap must return 200. Submit redirects, 404s, or 5xx and GSC validation fails.

newsSitemapWindow.description: News sitemap only contains entries from the last 48 hours. Stale entries are worse than missing ones.
newsSitemapWindow.implementation: Filter by publishedAt timestamp, not by a fixed list
